note: Curriculum grounding graph. Every practice item is authored against a node, so prescriptions are retrieved, never generated freehand.

nodes.subject: Math
nodes.title: Combining like terms
nodes.remediation: Only terms with the same variable part may be added; add their coefficients, keep the variable part unchanged.

items.text: A rectangle has sides (2x+3) and (x+1). Write and simplify its perimeter.

nodes.subject: Math
nodes.title: Solving linear equations in one variable
nodes.remediation: Move variable terms to one side and constants to the other, changing the sign each time a term crosses the equals sign.

items.text: Three times a number, minus 7, equals 20. Find the number with an equation.

nodes.subject: Math
nodes.title: Distributive property with negative coefficients
nodes.remediation: The factor multiplies every term inside the bracket, carrying its sign: a(b+c) = ab + ac, and a(b-c) = ab - ac.

items.text: Expand -3(2y-5) and use it to solve -3(2y-5) = 9

nodes.subject: Math
nodes.title: Adding fractions with unlike denominators
nodes.remediation: Rewrite both fractions over a common denominator before adding; never add denominators directly.

items.text: A recipe needs 1/2 cup and 1/3 cup of two liquids. How much in total?

nodes.subject: Math
nodes.title: Laws of exponents
nodes.remediation: a^m * a^n = a^(m+n); (a^m)^n = a^(mn). Bases must match before exponents are combined.

nodes.subject: Math
nodes.title: Square of a sum (perfect-square identity)
nodes.remediation: (a+b)^2 = a^2 + 2ab + b^2. The cross term 2ab is the part almost always dropped.

items.text: A square of side (x+4): express and expand its area.

nodes.subject: Physics
nodes.title: Newton's second law F = ma
nodes.remediation: Identify force, mass and acceleration in SI units first, then substitute into F = ma.

items.text: Find F when m = 2 kg and a = 3 m/s^2
A 5 kg block accelerates at 1.2 m/s^2. Find the net force.
A 1200 kg car accelerates from rest to 20 m/s in 8 s. Find the average net force.

nodes.subject: Physics
nodes.title: Unit conversion in SI
nodes.remediation: Convert every quantity to SI before substituting: grams to kilograms, km/h to m/s (divide by 3.6).

items.text: A 500 g mass is pushed with 10 N. Find its acceleration in SI units.

nodes.subject: Chemistry
nodes.title: Balancing chemical equations
nodes.remediation: Count atoms of each element on both sides, then adjust coefficients — never subscripts — until both sides match.

items.text: Balance CH4 + O2 -> CO2 + H2O and state how many O2 molecules are needed.

nodes.subject: English
nodes.title: Subject-verb agreement
nodes.remediation: Find the head of the subject first; modifiers between subject and verb do not change the number.
